description: A shell test script for Git, specifically testing the '--pathspec-from-file' option of 'git reset'. It sets up test scenarios, performs resets with various pathspec inputs, and verifies the outcomes.

methods.name: restore_checkpoint
methods.description: Resets the Git repository to the checkpoint tag using 'git reset --hard'.

methods.name: verify_expect
methods.description: Checks the status of specific files against expected output, verifying the effect of reset commands.

calls: git status --porcelain -- fileA.t fileB.t fileC.t fileD.t
